statements.markdown: **Theorem 9.48 (C: the one-sided finite decision boundary).** *The equivalence of Theorem [5.10](#thm:greedy-survival-record) separates two logically different kinds of evidence. A fatal greedy gap found at a finite rank is a finite certificate that $1/2\notin\mathcal A$. By contrast, membership requires survival at every rank; this paper supplies no finite certificate that the orbit survives forever and no completion theorem turning a long surviving prefix into membership.*
